verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference server, so outbound webhook callbacks (for example, on batch or job completion) are a fair capability to ask about, and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event-subscription mechanism. It covers only streaming outputs, the OpenAI-compatible API, and OpenAPI docs, none of which are webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
